profile.constituencyprofile_Text:
Dharmavaram Constituency in Sri Sathya Sai District of Andhra Pradesh, is renowned for Silk industry, fertile agricultural lands and the art of leather puppetry (TholuBommalata) craft. The constituency consisting of One Municipality (Dharmavaram), 73 Gram panchayats & 253 hamlets connects major urban centers like Ananthapuramu and YSR Kadapa districts. The national high way connectivity to Bangalore & Chennai in the constituency ropes the way to increase the trade sector.                       
Major livelihood in the constituency is Agriculture & allied sector followed by weaving. Cultivation of different commercial crops in horticulture boosts the economic development in the agriculture sector. The silks woven in Dharmavaramis nationally recognized for its beauty and brilliance by the 19th century. Dharmavaram Silk Saree has been Conferred with the Geographical Indication (GI) Status in 2013 with the GI Number 207. Leather Puppetry show in Nimmalakunta Village is a Geographical Indication (GI) tagged product (2008) from Andhra Pradesh is famous for its craft items that are made with goat leather. The process of this Art is done traditionally using naturally available material, natural dye colours as well as iron frames and the craft items include Lamp Shades, Paintings, Wall hangings, Door hangings, partitions and modern puppets.                                  
Dharmavaram Junction Railway Station (DMM) is the main railway station in Dharmavaram, Andhra Pradesh. It's a major railway junction in the state and is well-connected to many cities and towns in the region. The diversified resources in the constituency enhance the livelihood and sustainable development through strategic interventions.
profile.geography: The geography is characterized by fertile Red soils and a network of Chitravathi river and Chikkavadayar Tank of Dharmavaram, which is a lifeline for irrigation. The geographical area with 1333.61 sq. km of the constituency with 6% of its forest area includes 73% of its land under agriculture. It shares boundaries with Ananthapur, Raptadu and Puttaparthy constituencies.
profile.populationDesc: The Population of the constituency as per 2011 Census is 304706 consisting of 155211 male population and 149495 female population out of which 60% reside in rural areas and 40% residing in urban area. The constituency with a literacy rate of 61%, out of which male literacy rate 70.73%, female literacy rate 50.53%. The gender ratio stands at 966 females per 1,000 males.
profile.administrationDesc: Dharmavaram Constituency is one of the six assembly constituencies in Sri Satya Sai  District. It includes 1) Dharmavaram Mandal 2)Bathalapalli Mandal 3) Tadimarri Mandal and 4) Mudigubba Mandals  and also it has Dharmavaram municipality. Dharmavaram constituency comes under Hindupur Loksabha Constituency.
profile.educationHealthcareDesc: Social infrastructure includes one area hospital, five primary health centers (PHCs), and 95 sub-centers to meet the growing healthcare needs of the population. Educational infrastructure in the constituency comprises 201 Primary, 18 Upper primary, 36 high government schools, 16 junior colleges, 7-degree colleges and one Polytechnic college.
profile.culturalheritageDesc: In Dharmavaram Constituency, Sri Laxmi Chennakesava Swamy Temple is renowned for its architectural brilliance and for the perennial  waterspout and pillars, which produces seven different musical notes when struck. Few temples like Sangameswara in Bathalapalli, Kati koteswaraswamy in Tadimarri Mandal attracting the pilgrimages from different parts of the district during the festival of Mahashivaratri.

economy_text.economy_Text:
Dharmavaram constituency's economy is projected to experience robust growth, transitioning from Agri based toward balanced sectoral contributions while emphasizing sustainability and infrastructure. 

The Gross Constituency Domestic Product (GCDP) is forecasted to rise from Rs. 7,197 Cr to Rs. 14,454 Cr in 2028-29, reflecting an average annual growth of 16.12%

Growth Drivers: Food Processing units, Sericulture Plantations and Highway Connectivity.

Major Clusters: Silk Textile & Weaving (GI-tagged), Nimmalakunta Toys (GI-tagged) and Sheep Rearing
economy_text.gcdP_Growth_Text: Dharmavaram is witnessing steady economic momentum with a targeted 15% annual GCDP growth rate across key sectors like horticulture, silk-weaving and livestock. This growth trajectory aligns with the long-term vision of making the constituency a vibrant rural and economic hub by 2047

thrust.description: Development of modern dairy farms, poultry production, and processing units.
Promotion of traditional crafts, modern design integration, and export facilitation.
High-yield fruit, vegetable, and floriculture production with cold chain and export linkages.
Smart townships, affordable housing, commercial hubs and facilitating urbanization, attracting private investment, and supporting infrastructure-led growth.
